==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">Dim As Double prev, sgte
Dim As Integer cnt = 1

Input " ", prev

Do
    sgte = (prev + 3) * 0.86
    If prev = sgte Then Exit Do
    Print sgte
    prev = sgte
    cnt += 1
Loop

Print !"\nTook"; cnt; " iterations."

Sleep</syntaxhighlight>
